record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Functional Analysis and Function Theory
record.original_question: Does there exist a Baire space X, a compact space Y, and a separately continuous function f: X × Y -> R such that f has no points of continuity at all, i.e. C(f) = emptyset?

evidence.quote: By C(f) we denote the set of all points of continuity of a function f.
Problem 7.1. Does there exist a Baire space X, a compact Y and a separately continuous function f : X × Y → R for which C(f) = ∅?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a Baire space (i.e., a topological space in which the intersection of every countable family of dense open sets is dense), let Y be a compact Hausdorff space, and let f: X × Y → ℝ be a separately continuous function (i.e., for every fixed x₀ ∈ X the map y ↦ f(x₀, y) is continuous on Y, and for every fixed y₀ ∈ Y the map x ↦ f(x, y₀) is continuous on X). Denote by C(f) ⊆ X × Y the set of all points at which f is jointly continuous.

Does there exist such a triple (X, Y, f) with C(f) = ∅, that is, a separately continuous real-valued function on the product of a Baire space and a compact Hausdorff space which has no points of joint continuity?
artifact.status_search_result: A 2018 preprint by Maslyuchenko and Mykhaylyuk (arXiv:1809.05799, published in J. Inst. Math. Jussieu) constructs a separately continuous function e: E × K → {0,1} on the product of a Baire space E and a compact space K with no points of joint continuity, giving a negative solution to Talagrand's problem in the affirmative direction (such a triple exists).

status_evidence.title: On a problem of Talagrand concerning separately continuous functions
status_evidence.snippet: We construct a separately continuous function e:E×K→{0,1} on the product of a Baire space E and a compact space K such that no restriction of e to any non-meagre Borel set is continuous; in particular e has no points of joint continuity.
status_evidence.claim: The construction provides a Baire X, compact Y and separately continuous f with C(f)=∅, resolving the problem affirmatively.

status_evidence.title: On a problem of Talagrand concerning separately continuous functions — J. Inst. Math. Jussieu
status_evidence.snippet: Published version of the resolution of Talagrand's problem on separately continuous functions on Baire×compact products.
status_evidence.claim: Peer-reviewed publication of the negative answer to Talagrand's continuity question.
